author: Nerd of the Rings
description:
The first Middle-earth game under the new Middle-earth ownership has officially been announced!  We are getting a Middle-earth RPG from Warhorse Studios, makers of Kingdom Come: Deliverance!

As part of the announcement that Fellowship Entertainment will be spun off from Embracer, Warhorse Studios announced a third game in their KCD franchise as well as pre-production of a Middle-earth game!
title: Warhorse Middle-earth Game Announced
